description: The four-tier conspiracy behind the Meridian Spine fraud, designed as a controlled burn where the National Integrity Directorate itself is the capture instrument. The revealed order follows a strict escalation from executor (Lund) through intermediary (Okafor) and coordinator (Halveston) to architect (Marsh), with two sequential false answers that must be lifted before the final truth can emerge.

tiers.name: Petra Lund
tiers.function: Lead materials certifier on the Meridian Spine who signs off falsified load coupons using the same override method as Kessler. She is the offered first answer, a 'Renn-era method copycat,' guilty at the lowest tier.

tiers.name: Nadia Okafor
tiers.function: Iris's investigative partner at the Directorate, secretly steering Iris toward the financier (FA2) by feeding true-but-incomplete evidence to burn Halveston as the stopping point and shield Marsh. She believes the Directorate must survive even if it means a controlled sacrifice. The betrayal mechanism is guided investigation, not leaked finding.

tiers.name: Gerald Halveston
tiers.function: Chairs the philanthropic infrastructure fund financing the Spine. He moved the money that captured the contracts. He is the second false answer, appearing as the mastermind, but he financed; he did not architect.

tiers.name: Stellan Marsh
tiers.function: National figure who created the National Integrity Directorate 'so Kessler never happens again' and who chairs the council that stood above Renn. He architected the Directorate as a national capture instrument, laundering the same fraud at the scale of a country. He loses only to the physical tool-mark outside every registry he controls.

false_answers.label: A lone method-copycat
false_answers.how_lifted: The tooling that made the tool-mark was never in Lund's possession – the method came from above her.

false_answers.label: The money did it. Halveston.
false_answers.how_lifted: The fund only moved where the Directorate pointed it; the capture was architected by whoever built the Directorate, not by whoever financed it.

controlled_burn.description: The reform is the capture instrument: the National Integrity Directorate, built to prevent the next Kessler, is the mechanism by which the co-owners who financed Renn now control national procurement, laundering the same fraud at the scale of a country behind the credibility of the body meant to stop it.
three_piece_assembly: The same tool-mark recurring across projects the Directorate certified, linking the frauds
The Directorate's approvals consistently tracking the fund's investment positions
The timing of every 'clean verdict' landing where public trust needed restoring

authorship_ladder.ch17_18: Allowed: 'the reform is the capture instrument' / national capture; co-owners exist; 'a principal above the fund.' Forbidden: any named person (incl. Marsh) tied to architecting the capture; Marsh + built-the-Directorate-as-capture.
authorship_ladder.ch19: Allowed: Marsh + created-the-Directorate + benefits (interest/negligence – Tier 4 closing in). Forbidden: Marsh + architected-the-capture / ordered / laundered.
authorship_ladder.ch20: Unlocked: Marsh + architected the capture – binding_condition.canonical_text, exact when explicitly stated.

core_sample.note: The physical fingerprint of the fraud method: a specific machining/press tooling micro-signature that appears identically on Kessler's load test override and the Meridian Spine's certified coupons. The tool-mark is physical, recurring, and can only mean common authorship, regardless of redacted names.
